faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our local features and cloud services.

items.question: Are local profiles really free and unlimited?
items.answer: Yes! Unlike other anti-detect browsers that charge per local profile, Star Multlogin allows you to create and run as many profiles as your machine can handle at no additional charge.

items.question: How does the anti-fingerprinting technology work?
items.answer: Star Multlogin operates at the Chromium engine level, supplying authentic hardware parameters, fonts, WebGL, Canvas, AudioContext, and WebRTC configurations that prevent fraud engines from detecting anomalies.

items.question: Can I bring my own proxies from any provider?
items.answer: Yes. We support HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS5, and WireGuard VPN tunnels. You can bind dedicated proxies to specific profiles or update them dynamically.

items.question: When do I need a paid plan?
items.answer: Paid plans are only required if you want to back up profiles to the cloud, synchronize across devices, or collaborate with team members.

items.question: Does it support Windows, Mac, and Linux?
items.answer: Yes! We offer native 64-bit builds for Windows 10/11, macOS (Intel & Apple Silicon M1-M4), and Linux (AppImage & .deb).
